scripts.bootstrap:local: bun run localstack && bun run cdklocal bootstrap --all
scripts.cdklocal: AWS_PROFILE=000000000 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-central-1 cdklocal --app 'bun local.dev.ts'
scripts.deploy:local: bun run localstack && bun run bootstrap:local && bun run cdklocal deploy -- --all
scripts.dev: bun run localstack && bun run cdklocal watch
scripts.remove:local: bun run localstack && bun run cdklocal destroy -- --all
